faq.title: Frequently asked questions about wedding planning

1.question: How do I plan my wedding step by step?
1.answer: Mariable supports you at every step: 1) Create your free account, 2) Use our smart checklist to plan the major milestones, 3) Browse our vendors or request a personalized selection, 4) Manage your budget with our calculator, 5) Coordinate the day with our planning tool. All our tools are free to use.

2.question: How do I calculate my wedding budget?
2.answer: Our budget calculator helps you estimate and allocate your funds. It factors in the number of guests, region, season and your vendors. You get a realistic estimate per category (venue, caterer, photo, DJ, etc.) and can track your expenses in real time. The tool is 100% free.

3.question: Is Mariable really free?
3.answer: Yes — many features are 100% free: dashboard, checklist, budget calculator, guest management, seating plan and day-of coordination. Vendor search is free too. Mariable also offers premium features to go further in planning your wedding.

4.question: What does Premium include and how much is it?
4.answer: The Mariable Premium account is available for €29 (one-time payment, lifetime access). It includes: unlimited PDF exports, full access to checklists and guides, unlimited AI usage, unlimited document storage, and more than 3 lines per budget category.
